comparison.objective: Denest and park two reusable trays; candidate separates media in a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Tab grasping, vertical clearance, and tray placement versus pouring and agitating contents through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Both trays released in bays; candidate requires recovered media and retained washers.
comparison.reason: Despite using tray-like objects, denesting does not test screening.
